observerFindings.source: ACT_MOVE: 移动本身不发声、不影响守卫（首版无噪声机制）
observerFindings.analysis: No gameplay noise/hearing detection is a GDD decision. Saying movement itself produces no sound also specifies audible treatment, which the original assignment leaves to AUDIO_DESIGN.md. The two meanings are not equivalent.
observerFindings.downstreamImpact: Audio author may treat GDD as forbidding decorative movement sounds even though they have no detection consequence.
observerFindings.closure: Express the absence of gameplay noise/detection consequences without selecting audible treatment; leave actual sound behavior to the audio owner.

observerFindings.classification: boundary clarification, not a proven contradictory pair
observerFindings.analysis: The exit activates immediately on the last pickup and victory requires entering an already activated exit. The text can support requiring a new entry, but does not expressly settle activation while the player already overlaps the exit, including a last collectible reachable from that overlap. No layout has yet excluded that case. Do not claim this is an established contradiction.
observerFindings.downstreamImpact: If that geometry is allowed, consumers need to agree whether activation with occupancy wins immediately or requires leaving and re-entering; a layout guarantee excluding the case is also a possible owner decision.
observerFindings.closure: Clarify the intended occupancy/entry behavior, or explicitly establish that the case cannot occur; do not prescribe an engine update algorithm.
